1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CircularVoronoiRays
2 
3 /-! Recover the two endpoint angles and the empty-gap property from any
4 member of the finite list of cut directions, including its closing gap.
5 -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
8 
9 open Real Set
10 
11 /-- An ordinary consecutive gap or the last-to-first gap, in one full turn. -/
12 def IsCircularGap {n : ℕ} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (first last : Fin n) (α β : ℝ) : Prop :=
13   (∃ i j : Fin n, j.val = i.val + 1 ∧ α = θ i ∧ β = θ j) ∨
14     (α = θ last ∧ β = θ first + 2 * π)
15 
16 /-- The midpoint list and the explicit gap list describe the same directions. -/
17 theorem mem_circularGapMidpoints_iff {n : ℕ} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (first last : Fin n) (m : ℝ) :
18     m ∈ circularGapMidpoints θ first last ↔
19       ∃ α β, IsCircularGap θ first last α β ∧ m = (α + β) / 2 := by
20   constructor
21   · rintro (⟨i, j, next, midpoint⟩ | midpoint)
22     · exact ⟨θ i, θ j, Or.inl ⟨i, j, next, rfl, rfl⟩, midpoint⟩
23     · exact ⟨θ last, θ first + 2 * π, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, midpoint⟩
24   · rintro ⟨α, β, (⟨i, j, next, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩), midpoint⟩
25     · exact Or.inl ⟨i, j, next, midpoint⟩
26     · exact Or.inr midpoint
27 
28 /-- Earlier gap midpoints give disjoint ordered gap intervals, including
29 when the later interval crosses the angular cut. -/
30 theorem circular_gaps_separated {n : ℕ} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (increasing : StrictMono θ)
31     (bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i ∧ θ i < 2 * π) (first last : Fin n)
32     (at_first : first.val = 0) (at_last : last.val + 1 = n)
33     {α β γ δ : ℝ} (left : IsCircularGap θ first last α β)
34     (right : IsCircularGap θ first last γ δ) (ordered : (α + β) / 2 < (γ + δ) / 2) :
35     β ≤ γ ∧ δ ≤ α + 2 * π := by
36   rcases left with ⟨i, j, next, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
37     rcases right with ⟨k, l, after, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
38   · have before : j ≤ k := by
39       by_contra wrong
40       have ki : k ≤ i := by omega
41       have lj : l ≤ j := by omega
42       linarith [increasing.monotone ki, increasing.monotone lj]
43     exact ⟨increasing.monotone before, by linarith [(bounds l).2, (bounds i).1]⟩
44   · exact ⟨increasing.monotone (by omega), by linarith [increasing.monotone (show first ≤ i by omega)]⟩
45   · have k_last := increasing.monotone (show k ≤ last by omega)
46     have l_last := increasing.monotone (show l ≤ last by omega)
47     linarith [(bounds last).2, (bounds first).1]
48   · linarith
49 
50 /-- An explicit listed gap has its two source endpoints and no intervening
51 source copy; all angles are bounded in one turn from the first source. -/
52 theorem circular_gap_spec {sources : Set Plane} {n : ℕ} (sites : Fin n ≃ sources)
53     (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (increasing : StrictMono θ) (bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i ∧ θ i < 2 * π)
54     (z : Plane) (R : ℝ) (position : ∀ i, (sites i : Plane) = z + R • direction (θ i))
55     (first last : Fin n) (at_first : first.val = 0) (at_last : last.val + 1 = n)
56     (two : first < last) {α β : ℝ} (gap : IsCircularGap θ first last α β) :
57     α < β ∧ β < α + 2 * π ∧ θ first ≤ α ∧ β ≤ θ first + 2 * π ∧
58       z + R • direction α ∈ sources ∧ z + R • direction β ∈ sources ∧
59       ∀ p ∈ sources, ∃ φ ∈ Icc β (α + 2 * π), p = z + R • direction φ := by
60   rcases gap with ⟨i, j, next, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
61   · refine ⟨increasing (by omega), ?_, increasing.monotone (by omega), ?_,
62       position i ▸ (sites i).property, position j ▸ (sites j).property,
63       circular_order_gap sites θ increasing bounds z R position i j next⟩
64     · linarith [(bounds i).1, (bounds j).2]
65     · linarith [(bounds j).2, (bounds first).1]
66   · refine ⟨?_, ?_, increasing.monotone two.le, le_rfl,
67       position last ▸ (sites last).property, ?_,
68       closing_circular_order_gap sites θ increasing z R position first last at_first at_last⟩
69     · linarith [(bounds last).2, (bounds first).1]
70     · linarith [increasing two]
71     · rw [direction_add_two_pi]
72       exact position first ▸ (sites first).property
73 
74 /-- Each listed midpoint comes from an actual empty source gap in one turn. -/
75 theorem circular_midpoint_gap {sources : Set Plane} {n : ℕ} (sites : Fin n ≃ sources)
76     (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (increasing : StrictMono θ) (bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i ∧ θ i < 2 * π)
77     (z : Plane) (R : ℝ) (position : ∀ i, (sites i : Plane) = z + R • direction (θ i))
78     (first last : Fin n) (at_first : first.val = 0) (at_last : last.val + 1 = n)
79     (two : first < last) {m : ℝ} (member : m ∈ circularGapMidpoints θ first last) :
80     ∃ α β : ℝ, α < β ∧ β < α + 2 * π ∧ m = (α + β) / 2 ∧
81       θ first ≤ α ∧ β ≤ θ first + 2 * π ∧
82       z + R • direction α ∈ sources ∧ z + R • direction β ∈ sources ∧
83       ∀ p ∈ sources, ∃ φ ∈ Icc β (α + 2 * π), p = z + R • direction φ := by
84   obtain ⟨α, β, gap, midpoint⟩ := (mem_circularGapMidpoints_iff θ first last m).mp member
85   obtain ⟨ordered, width, low, high, first_source, second_source, empty_gap⟩ :=
86     circular_gap_spec sites θ increasing bounds z R position first last at_first at_last two gap
87   exact ⟨α, β, ordered, width, midpoint, low, high, first_source, second_source, empty_gap⟩
88 
89 end SixVertexUnfolding
